note: MDC access on Hunter Creek just above its mouth on Bryant Creek. The camping area is at the area's gravel lot, a short spur off Route AB: a lot about 20 by 40 m with a privy, and a small boulder-edged clearing beside it for tents and picnics. No built pads, so a rig stays on the lot. The creek is about 45 m off through timber. No water. The county roads east of the lot cross the creeks on low-water bridges; the approach from Ava on Route AB does not use them. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC designates a camping area at the lot (page 'camping area', map symbol, GIS point) with a privy - stays under the lot rule, rig on the lot. Vault toilet written. Phone matches. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Not waterfront stands. Pin 14 m off the gravel (minor).
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS (designated point at a lot): the page says 'Facilities/features:camping area, picnic area, privy, and two permanent streams (Hunter Creek, Bryant Creek)' and lists 'Individual Campsites'; the map (Last Updated 9/10/2026) legend has 'Camping Area' and draws Parking, Camping Area and Privy symbols together at the lot north of Route AB by Hunter Creek; GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 36.91845,-92.49682, 22 m from the lot's GIS point. Imagery (leaf-off, 0.12 m/px): a gravel lot about 20 x 40 m at the end of a 60 m gravel spur off Route AB, a privy at its south-east corner, and on its north-west side a cleared rectangle about 18 x 12 m edged with boulders (vehicles kept out - tent and picnic ground). No pads, so a motorhome camps on the lot. It is the Lick Creek case (designated camping at a lot with a privy), not a bare ramp lot; no brochure PDF on the page, so nothing says 'parking lot only' or 'not recommended'.

ACCESS / LOW-WATER CROSSINGS: the page's route is Highway 14 east from Ava, then Route AB north-east 3 miles to the access; the last 900 m of Route AB seen on imagery runs along the hillside south of Hunter Creek without crossing it, and the lot is 60 m off it. Two low-water bridges are close by but not on that approach: County Road 230 over Hunter Creek about 170 m east of the lot, and County Road 228 over Bryant Creek at the area's second (south-east) lot. No posted limit or 4WD wording on the page. Overpass (overpass.private.coffee) timed out twice, so road classes and fords were not checked in OSM; the distances here are imagery estimates.

WATER: the lot is on Hunter Creek (10-15 m wide), not Bryant Creek, which it joins about 250 m downstream. The lot edge is about 45 m from the creek through leaf-off bottomland timber with a gravel bar beyond. Stored not waterfront stands.
PIN (minor): stored 36.91845,-92.49682 (GIS point) is in the trees about 8 m off the lot's west edge; the lot centre is 36.91852,-92.49668 (14 m). Not worth a move on its own.
PHONE: stored 417-746-0291 matches the page's 'For more information call (417) 746-0291'.
Nothing else in the database within 3 km. No split (one camping point; the south-east lot has no camping symbol).
